Specify a location for a dotenv file. Default `.env`.

## CLI flag

Use `--env-file` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                         | Flag                 |
| --------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------- |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                           | `--env-file <value>` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                           | `--env-file <value>` |
| [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)                             | `--env-file <value>` |
| [`remotion compositions`](/docs/cli/compositions)               | `--env-file <value>` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)                     | `--env-file <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)             | `--env-file <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)               | `--env-file <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda compositions`](/docs/lambda/cli/compositions) | `--env-file <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)         | `--env-file <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun still`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/still)           | `--env-file <value>` |

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setDotEnvLocation('.my-env');
```
